problem: "With several instances, a cycle can exist while another free instance lets a process finish" is loose. In a wait-for graph a process is drawn waiting only when no instance of that type is free, so a free instance cannot be the reason the cycle clears. The real reason is a process outside the cycle that holds another instance of the requested type and can release it.
fix: "With several instances, a cycle can exist without deadlock: a process outside the cycle that holds another instance of the requested resource type may release it, which lets a waiting process in the cycle finish."
